### God Will Bring It to Mind at Just the Right Time
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-october-9-2025.html
Passage: John 14:26
Points:
- The Holy Spirit serves as a personal counselor and teacher, directing believers in faithful living.
- God communicates directly through internal thoughts, guidance, and ideas rather than an audible voice.
- The Spirit brings biblical truth to mind, which requires that believers first deposit that truth into their hearts.
- Memorizing and studying Scripture stores up wisdom that the Spirit recalls during moments of temptation and stress.

### The Promise of Another Helper
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/promise-of-another-helper
Passage: John 14:16–17
Points:
- Jesus demonstrated selfless servanthood by preparing His disciples for His departure rather than focusing on His coming ordeal.
- Receiving the Holy Spirit is an act of sovereign grace that enables obedience, not a reward earned by human effort.
- The Spirit comes as another advocate to stand beside believers, continuing the supportive ministry Jesus began.
- The Spirit defends believers against self-condemnation by confirming their pardon and illuminating biblical truth.
